title: Unity loads splat + collision mesh + environment spec
summary: The runtime loads a reconstructed environment: render the splat, load the collision mesh, parse environment_spec.json, and place the summit beacon, route markers, and vista sparkles per DESIGN_SYSTEM §1.

acceptance_tests.test: Given a corpus environment package, Unity renders the splat, loads the collision mesh, and parses environment_spec.json with no console errors.
The summit beacon, route markers (when a route is selected), and vista sparkles render per DESIGN_SYSTEM §1 and stay drawn on top with depth-fade.
acceptance_tests.evidence: screenshots on a bright and a dark scan

acceptance_tests.test: Meets the SPEC §6 quality targets on a current and an older iPhone with the debug-overlay report.
